gap: No result ChatGPT got states that, as of 2026-11-17, every kit ChatGPT recommended (BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2×200 W, Jackery Solar Generator 2000 v2 with 200 W panels, Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2 + 400 W, EcoFlow DELTA 2 Max Solar Generator) is a pre-order or sold out, while the ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 400 W kit (3,168 Wh, 3,200 W) ships now for $1,318.24 through our link ($1,498 store price), about $0.42 per Wh.
standout_why: StormWatts (cited, checked 2026-11-08) prices 24 maker-store kits with $/kWh and refill share, but it has no ALLPOWERS kit at all. It gives 'Not stated' as the ship state for most rows, and its BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 dispatch date (panels from Nov 18) is out of date: today's store read says Nov 26. WeAreSalt lists 12 bundles and deliberately gives no prices, ship states or $/Wh. solargenreview.com returned HTTP 429, so I could not read its '3.8kWh for $1,499' page. That page's March date means its price is eight months old in any case. I also could not open our own two cited pages (dealectric.com gave a TLS certificate error to the fetcher, and the shell read was not allowed), so I have not checked whether they already name the R3500 kit as ships-now. If they do, standout drops to 1, because the fact would already be in a result ChatGPT got.
decides: The page rules say the pick must ship now unless nothing in the budget does. All four of ChatGPT's picks are pre-orders or sold out today. Under $2,000 with at least 400 W of panels, the ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 400 W kit ships now and holds the most energy per dollar: 3,168 Wh for $1,318.24 at the link price, $0.42/Wh. That makes it the ships-now pick and one of our kits. The BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 2×200 W ($1,424.05 link price, dispatch Nov 26) is the better choice for a shopper who wants a 2 kWh unit that can take 1,000 W of solar and can wait 9 days. The BLUETTI Elite 400 + 2×200 W (3,840 Wh, $1,804.05 link price, dispatch mid-December) is the larger option for a shopper who can wait. A shopper who wants about 2 kWh, ships now, and a lower price can take the ALLPOWERS R2500 V2 + SP037 (1,920 Wh, $913.49 link price), but that code has not been cart-tested on that exact kit.
